ringContribution.inputs: Ortiz2017 ring radius2287km,width70km; assumed surface density500–1000kg/m2 borrowed from Saturn A ring
ringContribution.limitations: Surface density is an analogy/assumption, not a Haumea ring measurement. No Saturn texture/chemistry or calibrated ring rendering adopted. Ring physical registration remains OPEN.

unseenSatellites.reportedSearchLimit: Burkhart2016 cited diameter>60km within10000km; underlying completeness not independently audited here
unseenSatellites.limitations: Illustrative mass/density assumptions, NOT discovery, measured moon composition, exhaustive absence or current orbital inventory. Authors conclude ring/unseen contributions negligible under these assumptions.

interiorModels.method: Modified kyushu/Hachisu two-layer hydrostatic-equilibrium Fortran code with Python parameter scan; author benchmarks reported, not independently reproduced
interiorModels.assumptions: Crust density921kg/m3, nominal Haumea mass and rotation; axes are model inputs, not new independent measurements or moon axes
interiorModels.fossilTest: 3.7hour historical rotation assumption with more sparsely sampled same axis grid
limitations: Frozen-in figure is a tested hypothesis, NOT reconstructed observed history or present moon rotation.
Detailed core/mantle densities, layering, porosity and historical cooling remain model dependent.
No code execution, new shape mesh, ring registration, photometric calibration, moon chemistry or geography supplied.
Haumea reference radius772km must not be assigned to Namaka or Hiʻiaka.
